title: dryas octopetala subsp. hookeriana
intro: Dryas octopetala subsp. hookeriana, commonly known as the Mountain Avens, is a flowering plant species native to high-altitude regions of the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, potentially alleviating symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-tumor properties. The bioactive constituents in Mountain Avens may also contribute to its potential as an immunomodulator and anti-inflammatory agent.
